description: A server that lets another program on the same computer read and change the patch over a local network socket, sending it lines of JSON
notes: the lamp in the middle of the panel is lit while the server is listening. It has no jacks and no knobs, and nothing about it reaches the audio engine.
the server accepts connections on the loopback address only, and one client at a time. There is no password: anything that can open the socket can control Rack.
menu: Server enabled — starts and stops the listening socket without removing the module; the lamp goes dark while it is stopped
TCP port — the port to serve on: 7000, 7001, 7002, 7777 or 8000 from the list, or any number from 1 to 65535 typed into the field below them
